name: 眨眼频率分析
description: Analyzes eye blink patterns for naturalness — AI often generates unnatural blink rates
algorithm: Blink Rate Analysis — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye blinking patterns for deepfake detection following Li et al. (2018) "In Ictu Oculi":

1. **眼睛状态分类**: For each frame, the eye aspect ratio (EAR) is computed from eye landmarks: EAR = (‖p2−p6‖ + ‖p3−p5‖) / (2‖p1−p4‖), where p1-p6 are the eye contour landmarks. EAR drops significantly during blinks, enabling frame-level open/closed classification.

2. **眨眼事件检测**: Consecutive frames with low EAR form blink events. Each blink is characterized by duration (typically 100-400ms in natural blinking), amplitude (EAR change magnitude), and velocity profile (rapid closing, slightly slower opening following Evinger et al., 1991).

3. **眨眼频率统计分析**: The inter-blink interval (IBI) distribution is analyzed. Natural spontaneous blinking occurs at 15-20 blinks/minute with a characteristic IBI distribution following a gamma or log-normal model. Early deepfake methods produced subjects that rarely or never blinked — a key detection cue identified by Li et al. (2018).

4. **眨眼自然度评估**: Individual blink kinematics are evaluated: natural blinks are bilateral (both eyes close simultaneously), show stereotyped velocity profiles, and exhibit physiological reflexes (increased blink rate during speech, periodic patterns). AI-generated blinks may appear unilateral, show unnatural velocity profiles, or lack expected behavioral correlations.

5. **时间模式评分**: The overall blink pattern is scored against natural human behavior models. Anomalies include: absence of blinks, unnatural blink rates, irregular blink dynamics, asymmetric blinking, or blinks that don't correspond to expected cognitive/behavioral triggers. The score quantifies deviation from natural blink physiology.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through blink rate analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2018). In Ictu Oculi: Exposing AI Created Fake Videos by Detecting Eye Blinking. WIFS.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
